intro.text: A Shin outcast bound to obey whoever holds their Oathstone, in everything except taking their own life.

description.text: The idea of the Truthless probably comes from Stone Shamanism: Szeth avoids questioning its tenets for fear of questioning his own status.

Outsiders value Truthless for their obedience, but the Shin consider them worthless. Being named Truthless is a terrible Shin punishment: they must bear the guilt of every deed they are ordered to do, and may not end their own lives, prolonging their suffering.

Whoever holds a Truthless's Oathstone is their master. The stone has no magic; only a sense of honour holds the Truthless to their orders. If a Truthless knows their Oathstone is unheld, they must retrieve it and wait quietly until someone interacts with them.
Szeth's Oathstone is a plain, sphere-sized chunk of rock with quartz crystals and an iron vein.

items.text: Szeth was named Truthless for claiming that the Voidbringers and Knights Radiant would return, which the Shin leaders called a dangerous lie. The Stone Shamans mean to reclaim his Blade when he dies.
When Szeth learns his claim was true, he decides he was never truly Truthless and stops following its rules.
